versions.changelog:
v1.0.1 Changelog

- Updated skill description to add "infringing products" as a recognized trigger keyword and clarify output requirements.
- Patsnap disclaimer revised: now only included in report files, not printed in chat; wording simplified and attribution updated.
- Removed Chinese from all instruction/disclaimer text; all guidance and disclaimers are now in English.
- Clarified placement of disclaimer: now inserted as Section 0 and the final section of each report file.
- Minor edits to instructions on lead discovery and reporting, including more concise search example queries.
- No code or logic changes; documentation only.

Initial release of the Evidence of Use (EOU) patent analysis skill provided by Patsnap (智慧芽).

- Enables users to analyze patent infringement, generate EOU claim charts, map patent claims to product features, and discover potential infringement leads.
- Triggers on EOU-related keywords in both English and Chinese; works even with partial inputs (e.g., just a patent number or product name).
- Automates the search for potential infringing products and prepares professional EOU and claim chart reports.
- All generated reports must include Patsnap’s mandatory disclaimer and product link at both the beginning and end.
- Reports and user-facing output are automatically adapted to the user's language.
